status: adopted - decision D1 in phase6_research_decisions_v1.md (documented for supervisor information; reversible via version stamps)
change_note: Adds two NATIONAL codes. The Step 3 pilot showed the local-oriented taxonomy leaves most national-arm articles uncodable (23 of 67 records had no primary issue, concentrated in national politics coverage), which would blank out the local-vs-national issue-composition comparison the research design calls for. The new codes mirror the supervisor's own national search topics (party leadership, government and opposition performance, cost of living, tax). Purely additive; issues-v1.1/v1.2 records remain valid under their own stamps and rule S7 forbids the new codes under old stamps.

codes.planning_housing: planning decisions, housing development, green belt building
codes.local_business: local economy, high streets, business support
codes.immigration: immigration and asylum policy or local impact
codes.council_performance: competence and delivery of the council
codes.service_closure: closure or reduction of public services
codes.local_government_reorganisation: unitary reorganisation, boundary and structure changes
codes.new_party_emergence: emergence or rise of a new party
codes.election_administration: election process and administration - polling arrangements, voting procedures, counting arrangements, election administration issues
codes.national_politics: NEW in v1.3: national party leadership, government and opposition performance, parliamentary and party affairs without a specific policy issue
codes.national_economy: NEW in v1.3: national economic policy - cost of living, national tax and spending, growth, employment
